title: BrainBind: Bridging Synchronized EEG and fMRI through Long-Form Naturalistic Video Representations
abstract: arXiv:2611.05581v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Real-world vision is dynamic and scene-rich, while EEG and fMRI resolve it at complementary temporal and spatial scales. Most neural decoding systems, however, align one modality in isolation and mostly against static images or short clips. We study the synchronized case: EEG and fMRI are recorded during the same long-form naturalistic viewing, giving a shared stimulus but also recurring narrative context and many semantically similar candidates. We present BrainBind, a framework that maps synchronized EEG and fMRI into frozen long-form video embedding spaces and treats those spaces as common visual-semantic references, not literal neural codes. On CineBrain, a five-seed Recall@K 2 x 4 matrix across two video anchors and four system configurations shows distinct retrieval profiles. With Omni, fMRI organizes the full candidate list most strongly (MRR = 23.82, nDCG@10 = 25.31), while Joint-Dual gives the highest mean label-aware R@1 (13.52

translated_title: BrainBind：通过长时自然视频表征连接同步记录的EEG与fMRI
translated_abstract: 真实世界的视觉是动态且场景丰富的，而EEG和fMRI分别以互补的时间尺度和空间尺度来解析它。然而，大多数神经解码系统仅对齐单一模态，且大多针对静态图像或短片段。我们研究同步记录的情形：在相同的长时间自然观看过程中同时记录EEG和fMRI，这不仅提供了共享的刺激，还带来了反复出现的叙事上下文以及大量语义相似的候选样本。我们提出BrainBind，一个将同步的EEG和fMRI映射到冻结的长时视频嵌入空间的框架，并将这些空间视为共同的视觉-语义参照，而非字面上的神经编码。在CineBrain数据集上，跨越两个视频锚点和四种系统配置的五种子Recall@K 2×4矩阵展现出不同的检索特征。使用Omni时，fMRI对完整候选列表的排序能力最强（MRR = 23.82，nDCG@10 = 25.31），而Joint-Dual则取得了最高的平均标签感知R@1（13.52
tldr: 提出BrainBind框架，将同步记录的EEG与fMRI映射到冻结的长时自然视频嵌入空间中作为共同的视觉-语义参照，从而在长时自然观看场景下实现多模态脑信号的跨模态检索与解码。
en_tdlr: BrainBind maps synchronized EEG and fMRI recordings into frozen long-form naturalistic video embedding spaces as common visual-semantic references, enabling cross-modal neural retrieval and decoding under long-form naturalistic viewing.
